verses.1: On the third day, Esther became queen. She stood in the inner courtyard of the royal palace, attending to the affairs of the king. The king sat on his throne in the royal hall, while Esther stood at the entrance of the room.
verses.2: And when the king saw Queen Esther standing in the courtyard, he was pleased with her appearance. So the king handed over the golden crown that was in his hand to Esther. Then Esther approached and touched the head of the crown.
verses.3: And the king said to her, “What do you want, Queen Esther? What is it you seek, so that I may give it to you?”
verses.4: And Esther said, “If it is good for the king, then let the king and his men go to the one I have prepared for them.”
verses.5: And the king said, “Hurry up and do what Esther has commanded.” So the king and Haman went to see the person who had done what Esther ordered.
verses.6: And the king said to Esther, “What is your request? I will grant it. What do you desire, and will it be granted?”
verses.7: And Esther said, “My request and my plea.”
verses.8: If I have won the king’s favor, and if it is pleasing to the king to grant my requests and fulfill my desires, then the king will come and bring those who are worthy of being treated with respect. After that, I will do as the king desires.
verses.9: And that day, Manoah went out with a happy and cheerful heart. When he saw Mordecai at the king’s door, he did not get up or show any reaction toward him. Instead, Manoah filled Mordecai with anger.
verses.10: And he went out, entered his house, and sent for his lovers and his concubines.
verses.11: And He told them about the glory of his twelve sons and many of their children. He also mentioned all those who were raised by the king, as well as those who served as his officials and servants.
verses.12: And Haman said, “Even though Esther did not bring the queen along with the king to the banquet, yet I still command that she be brought there with the king.”
verses.13: And all this does not matter to me at any time when I see my Jewish brother sitting in the gate of the king.
verses.14: And his wife and all his lovers said to him, “Let’s plant a tree that is fifty amah tall.” In the morning, they told the king, “Let us hang Mordecai on that tree.” When they went with the king to the place where the tree was to be planted, it turned out to be a happy thing. So they planted the tree.
